messages:
maggie: heads-up — planning rollout for conditional-model-routing next month. thinking staged slices: 0.5% canary -> 5% small -> 25% ramp -> full. primary success metrics: P95 latency delta <= 5%, error rate <0.2% absolute, and no regression on our eval prompt set. we also need per-tenant opt-out and an immediate kill-switch.
ajay: sounds good. are we doing region-first (us-west) then global, or tenant-first? also how do flags look?
neha: prefer region-first for infra isolation. us-west -> eu-west -> rest. need circuit-breaker thresholds per-AZ. if token queue depth > 150 or GPU mem spikes > 85% for 3m, auto-fallback.
maggie: agree region-first. feature flags I propose: `conditional.routing.v1` global gate, plus `conditional.routing.v1.%region%` and `conditional.routing.v1.tenant_override.%tenant_id%`. default off.
ajay: can you paste a sample config? helps SRE + infra to wire up monitoring.
maggie: sure — sample snippet:
```json
{
  "flag": "conditional.routing.v1",
  "stages": [
    {"slice": "canary", "pct": 0.5, "region": "us-west"},
    {"slice": "small", "pct": 5, "region": "us-west"},
    {"slice": "ramp", "pct": 25, "region": "us-west"}
  ],
  "fallback": {"type": "model_variant", "variant": "baseline-v1"}
}
```
sam: for A/B we should run a simultaneous quality-check harness: online sampling + offline evals. variants: control(baseline-v1), experiment(compressed-route-v2), experiment2(kv-cache-optim). primary quality signals: semantic-sim similarity on our eval set, and human-sampled safety checks. also track downstream metrics (CTR for suggestion flows).
neha: operational guardrails:
- auto-roll-back if P95 latency increases > 8% for 15m
- auto-fallback to baseline if error rate spikes > 0.5% absolute for 5m
- abort ramp if any AZ reports >3% 5xxs for 10m
we'll create dashboards and a paged alert to SRE on those conditions.
maggie: launch criteria checklist draft:
- infra: region staging run completed (smoke + load), circuit-breakers configured
- telemetry: dashboards + alerts exist, canary-run passed 24h with no gate triggers
- ml: offline eval no regression, online sample quality within epsilon (>=98% pass rate on eval prompts)
- product: 1 customer pilot ok (if customer-driven request) or signed-off internal QA
if all green, proceed with 5% ramp.
ajay: where do customer-driven asks fit? some customers want immediate tenant override. do we allow per-tenant opt-in before global ramp?
maggie: we will. explicit tenant opt-in allowed via tenant_override flag. request flow: SE creates ticket, product approves, set flag for tenant_id. must run in canary region only initially.
sam: one technical note: route compression may change tokenization slightly. include a small drift alert for embedding-similarity drops > 0.03.
neha: agreed. add to telemetry: embedding-sim delta, hallucination proxy (factuality score), and error budget burn-rate.
deploy-bot: deploy pipeline queued: `canary/conditional-routing/v1` — started 1778001500, estimated 12m. (job: ci/canary-deploy) :rocket:
maggie: nice. plan for rollout meeting tomorrow 10am PT to sign off on canary. agenda: smoke checklist, SLO gates, tenant opt-in process, rollback playbook. @neha @ajay @sam pls bring dashboards and runbook links.
ajay: I'll bring the runbook and the gating playbook.
neha: I'll prepare dashboard links and alert docs.
sam: I'll attach eval results and the sampling plan.
maggie: final question — do we want a dark-launch shadow mode first (mirror traffic) or direct small %? pros/cons?
ajay: shadow lets us catch regressions without user impact but doesn't exercise live latency. recommend shadow for 24h then 0.5% direct canary.
neha: +1 to that flow. shadow for 24h in us-west, check mem/cpu/kv cache behavior.
maggie: ok locked: shadow 24h -> 0.5% canary -> gates -> 5% -> 25% -> full. I'll update the rollout doc: https://redwood-internal/docs/conditional-routing-rollout (draft). thanks all :+1:
